room_rent.note: Variant plan: base is Single Private AC Room; some SI bands capped at 1% of SI/day per Policy Schedule

icu.note: Variant: 2% of SI/day or 'no limit' depending on Policy Schedule

copayment.note: No base co-pay under 61; mandatory 20% per claim if eldest insured aged 61+ at first issue

sub_limits.note: Cataract treatment capped; room/ICU may be percentage-capped — budget plan

maternity.note: Maternity excluded from base (Excl18); available via optional Maternity & New Born Cover

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% flat SI/yr, capped at 150%; only if claim-free; forfeited/reduced on claim

restoration.note: Unlimited re-instatement of base SI per year

ambulance.note: VERIFY ₹ cap — road ambulance up to schedule amount; Air Ambulance optional

modern_treatments.note: Advance Technology Methods up to specified limit

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded (Excl18); cataract sub-limit; room/ICU percentage caps possible; standard IRDAI Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Maternity & New Born, OPD Care, Air Ambulance, Home Care, Deductible, Smart Select, International Second Opinion, Annual Health Check-up
